mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_ID AS "roleId" , NAME AS "name" , REMARK AS "description" , '' AS "permission" FROM ROLES WHERE STATUS = '01' AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR ROLE_ID ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' ) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ROLE_ID ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM ROLES WHERE STATUS IN ( '01' , '02' ) AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR ROLE_ID ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' )

SELECT r.ROLE_ID AS "roleId" , r.NAME AS "roleName" , p.permission_id AS "permissionId" , p.remark AS "description" FROM role_permissions rp LEFT JOIN ROLES r ON r.role_id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN permissions p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id WHERE r.role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROLES ( ROLE_ID, CREATED_AT, STATUS, NAME, REMARK, FIRST_REGISTER_BRANCH, FIRST_REGISTER_USER, FIRST_REGISTER_DATE, FIRST_REGISTER_TIME, LAST_CHANGE_BRANCH, LAST_CHANGE_USER, LAST_CHANGE_DATE, LAST_CHANGE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{roleId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{status}, '01'), #{name}, #{description}, #{firstRegisterBranch}, #{firstRegisterUser}, #{firstRegisterDate}, #{firstRegisterTime}, #{lastChangeBranch}, #{lastChangeUser}, #{lastChangeDate}, #{lastChangeTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_ID AS "roleId" , NAME AS "name" , REMARK AS "description" , STATUS AS "status" FROM ROLES WHERE STATUS IN ( '01' , '02' ) AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR ROLE_ID ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' ) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ROLE_ID ASC
